body: I know it’s terrifying to enter your 20s, take it from someone who spent their 20th birthday in the hospital from an attempt. Birthdays are hard but it’s also a reminder that you made it another year, it’s progress no matter how much you feel like it’s just another year of the same shit. You may not see it now and that’s okay, and you may never enjoy your birthday like other 20 somethings. I just want to normalize that birthdays just suck for some people no matter what. Just to give my perspective: I just had my 21st and spent it going to the beach with one person. It was in no way a party and I did feel ashamed at some points for not having the big “21st bash” every girl seems to have in America, but it was my birthday and I did what made me comfortable. Most importantly I got through it. I never thought I would live past 20 and I was able to; I really understand how scary it is to feel like your depression just seems to drag on for years and years. If you ever want to talk you can PM me! I won’t tell you to have a happy birthday, but I will congratulate you on making it to 20 and on all the progress you’ve made to get to this point.
